args.goal: On the buyer's RFQ create screen, open the Participants or Invite Vendor control, choose the option to invite a new vendor, enter the vendor name and email abc@, and stop when the form visibly refuses the email.

steps.note: Perform the new-vendor invitation interaction, including the malformed email, which is not represented by a dedicated catalog step.
Assert the expected validation refusal for the malformed email.
